name: Color-Sliced-Pattern-B
$description: Two layers, each from its own source (Vanesa, 2026-11-24). Base: Color-Sliced-Pattern-A, inherited whole (every colorway, the approved stripes, its slices), so A's changes reach B. Letters on top: generative-glyph-layer-a, varied with the Pattern Studio connector's terminal look through fromStudioParams(). An agent makes a B by picking an A colorway (and stripes) and a terminal-look letter variation: renderPattern(canvas, tokens, B, { colorway, stripes, letters }).
